qhsk608we4.blurb:
How Kyoto Breaks Your Heart is a collection about the ways in which heartbreak can fill a place and make it impossible to stay.
20-something and uncertain about her future, Florentyna Leow is exhilarated when an old acquaintance offers her an opportunity for work and cohabitation in a little house in the hills of Kyoto.
Florentyna begins a new job as a tour guide, taking tourists on elaborate and expensive trips around Kyoto’s cultural hotspots. Amidst the busy tourist traps and overrun temples, Florentyna develops her own personal map of the city: a favourite smoky jazz kissa; a top-shelf katsuobushi loving cat; an elderly lady named Yamaguchi-san, who shares her sweets and gives Florentyna a Japanese name.
Meanwhile, her relationship with her new companion develops an intensity as they live and work together. Their little kitchen, the epicenter of their shared life, overlooks a community garden dominated by a fruitful persimmon tree. Their relationship burns bright, but seasons change, the persimmon tree out back loses its fruit, and things grow strange between the two women.
qhsk608we4.note: Inpress (The Emma Press's distributor), same text as theemmapress.com; the publisher repeats the opening sentence at the end, left off here

rihpt6dxoz.blurb:
'You cannot interfere with fate. Who are you to judge who should live and who should die?'

Death comes to us all. When he came to Mort, he offered him a job.

Death is the Grim Reaper of the Discworld, a black-robed skeleton with a scythe who ushers souls into the next world. He is also fond of cats and endlessly baffled by humanity.

Soon Death is yearning to experience what humanity really has to offer, but to do that, he'll need to hire some help.

It's an offer Mort can't refuse. As Death's apprentice he'll have free board, use of the company horse - and being dead isn't compulsory.

It's a dream job - until Mort falls in love with Death's daughter, Ysabell, and discovers that your boss can be a killer on your love life . . .
rihpt6dxoz.note: Penguin UK current edition (her copy is the older Corgi one); review quotes and series lines left off

u3n6i49gnz.blurb:
The girls are back – but they're not very happy! Ellie's glorious romance with Russell is teetering on the rocks. Magda's lost her pet and is desperately upset (though the others didn't even know she had a hamster!). And Nadine is fed up with the other two lecturing her about the dangers of meeting someone from the internet IRL – she thinks the guy she's chatting to online is wonderful . . .

Buckets of tears are wept and hundreds of tissues are sniffled into – can the girls survive these testing times?
u3n6i49gnz.note: Penguin UK 2025 reissue; wording updated (mentions 'IRL'), her 2002 Doubleday hardback's flap text may differ

3kxuzj2arj.blurb:
Is anything bothering you? Problems in class or at home? Don't know where to turn for help? Log on to the Worry Website! Type in your worry and wait for the good advice to flow in.

At least that's the plan when Mr Speed sets up his super-cool new Worry Website. Holly, Greg, Natasha and the rest of the class think they've got shedloads of worries. But, as they find out, sometimes the best advice comes from the most unexpected place.
3kxuzj2arj.note: Penguin UK page for her exact ISBN (Corgi Yearling)

u3n6iqugnz.blurb:
Rachel and her brother Eric are extraordinary. She is a spell-maker, able to fly, take any shape, see far and wide with her many-coloured eyes. He is a destroyer of spells.
On the planet Ool, home of the Witches, the high Witch Heebra wants Rachel and Eric crushed, and her old adversaries the Wizards slayed. A party of Witches is dispatched to Earth to locate the thousands of children who have powers like Rachel’s, and turn them into a ferocious army.
Rachel, in search of the children, finds their magic at work across the world. In Africa she encounters the infant Yemi, whose gifts transcend all others. In Chile she meets the menacing Heiki, a girl who will perform any evil to win the approval of the Witches. And in the frozen wastes of the Arctic she and Eric engage in a desperate struggle for the hearts and minds of all children.
u3n6iqugnz.note: Author's own site (book page blurb); the site's hard line breaks inside sentences joined

ls5xdoq7b9.blurb:
The magic of all children has been released. Throughout the skies of Earth they swoop, crossing continents, changing shape, diving to the ocean depths and playing the deadly new spell-games.
Rachel bides her time, watching the skies for what she knows will happen - the invasion of the Witches. But when it comes it is not in the way anyone expects, and there is also a new enemy — the huge, terrifying Gridda-breed.
To confront them will require all of Rachel's and her brother Eric's skill and courage, as they embark on a journey that takes them to Ool, home of the Witches — a world where mountains move and breathe, the sun never pierces the clouds and the snows are alive.
ls5xdoq7b9.note: Author's own site (book page blurb); the site's hard line breaks inside sentences joined

kjgn45bysl.blurb: The Strega-Borgia children are still reeling from the shock of their nanny's disappearance at the end of DEEP TROUBLE. Without Flora to tend to them the kids are growing up fast. Indeed, Titus is in the throes of a deeply embarrassing and magically accelerated puberty, while all around the usual chaos reigns. Baby Damp is learning to fly under the tutelage of a bat called Vesper, Ffup the dragon is struggling with the Atkins diet and Tarantella the tarantula is trying to teach her daughters the rudiments of mascara. So far, so StregaSchloss, but add in an arrest for murder, a demon intent on revenge and a suicidal deep-frozen ancestor and you have a recipe that could only be cooked up in a Gliori-cauldron.
kjgn45bysl.note: Penguin UK (Corgi paperback); her copy is the 2005 Doubleday hardback

add0002.blurb: Life is waiting to happen to Hubert Bird. But first he has to open his front door and let it in. In weekly phone calls to his daughter in Australia, widower Hubert Bird paints a picture of the perfect retirement, packed with fun, friendship and fulfilment. But Hubert Bird is lying. The truth is day after day drags by without him seeing a single soul. Until, that is, he receives some good news - good news that in one way turns out to be the worst news ever, news that will force him out again, into a world he has long since turned his back on. Now Hubert faces a seemingly impossible task: to make his real life resemble his fake life before the truth comes out. Along the way Hubert stumbles across a second chance at love, renews a cherished friendship and finds himself roped into an audacious community scheme that seeks to end loneliness once and for all . . . Life is certainly beginning to happen to Hubert Bird. But with the origin of his earlier isolation always lurking in the shadows will he ever get to live the life he's pretended to have for so long? From bestselling author Mike Gayle, All the Lonely People is by turns a funny and moving meditation on love, race, old age and friendship that will not only charm and uplift, but also remind you of the power of ordinary people to make an extraordinary difference.
add0002.note: Hachette UK (Hodder); audiobook copyright line left off

Solve the mystery with the Secret Seven - everyone's favourite detective club! 

When the Secret Seven go star-gazing , they end up spying on the town, and witness a fire being started. Can they react before someone gets hurt?
There’s more adventure and mystery to be found at the local fair, in a haunted house – in fact, wherever the Seven go!
Here are six stories, each complete in itself, and as exciting as the full-length adventure.

Join Rebecca and her friends at Trebizon, perfect for fans of Enid Blyton's Malory Towers and St Clare's.

New girl Rebecca Mason arrives at Trebizon, the famous boarding school, after everyone else has already made friends. Lonely and anxious to prove herself, Rebecca writes something for the school magazine, which unexpectedly triggers a row and half the school turns against her. Luckily, she discovers she has friends after all, the best friends any new girl could hope for.
The first exciting book in the classic Trebizon series.

The second exciting book in the classic Trebizon series.

The fifth exciting book in the classic Trebizon series.

The ninth exciting book in the classic Trebizon series.

ob32jko0an.blurb:
Zorian Kazinski has all the time in the world to get stronger, and he plans on taking full advantage of it.
A teenage mage of humble birth and slightly above-average skill, Zorian is attending his third year of education at Cyoria's magical academy. A driven and quiet young man, he is consumed by a desire to ensure his own future and free himself of the influence of his family, resenting the Kazinskis for favoring his brothers over him. Consequently, Zorian has no time for pointless distractions, much less other people's problems.
As it happens, though, time is something he is about to get plenty of.
On the eve of Cyoria's annual summer festival, Zorian is murdered, then abruptly brought back to the beginning of the month, just before he was about to take the train to school. Finding himself trapped in a time loop with no clear end or exit, he will have to look both within and without to unravel the mystery set before him. He does have to unravel it, too, because the loop clearly wasn’t made for his sake, and in a world of magic even a time traveler isn't safe from those who wish him ill.
Fortunately for Zorian, repetition is the mother of learning….
ob32jko0an.note: Wraithmarked Creative (the publisher's own shop), paperback

u3n6ix0gnz.blurb:
As the months in the time loop seem to add up without end, Zorian forms alliances with acquaintances old and new in an effort to solve the mystery of the loop and save his city—maybe even the world—from destruction.
But while his mage skills develop and he pursues more advanced and unusual forms of magic, Zorian must battle necromancers, fanatical cultists, and vicious creatures—all while avoiding the attention of the lich who could kill him...permanently.
u3n6ix0gnz.note: Wraithmarked Creative (the publisher's own shop), paperback

ayjgsfrpsz.blurb:
Darren Shan’s acclaimed Demonata series continues with more shocks, demons and thrilling twists in the chilling, Bec.
“I'm almost through the door when something breathes behind me, ‘Beccccc…’ I turn. I can't see anything but I know I'm not alone. I want to call for help but I can't. Then, in a blur, claws dart out of the darkness… a twisted face… fiery eyes… rows of teeth… the demon grabs me!”
As a baby, Bec fought for her life. As a trainee priestess, she fights to fit in to a tribe that needs her skills but fears her powers. And when the demons come, the fight becomes a war.
Bec's magic is weak and untrained, until she meets the druid Drust. Under his leadership, Bec and a small band of warriors embark on a long journey through hostile lands to confront the Demonata at their source.
But the final conflict demands a sacrifice too horrific to contemplate…
ayjgsfrpsz.note: AbeBooks synopsis for her exact ISBN; this is HarperCollins' own copy (harpercollins.co.uk blocks fetching)

izer0celqm.blurb: The Discworld is an unpredictable place, what with rivers you can skateboard across (if they weren't so knobbly), rocks that like a stroll about of an evening and points of raw magic that can turn a body inside out soon as look at it. For safety's sake, you need a guide! The DISCWORLD COMPANION contains everything you need to know about the Discworld. This edition, the first major revision since HOGFATHER was published (1997), covers the eight DISCWORLD novels from JINGO onwards, including THE LAST HERO and MAURICE AND HIS AMAZING EDUCATED RODENTS, as well as the Diaries, the plays and other Discworld Spinoffery.
izer0celqm.note: AbeBooks synopsis for her exact ISBN (Gollancz 2004); publisher's jacket copy

6uc5rg98dt.blurb: A school trip to Florence seems like the perfect escape for Lucy. She wants time away from Tony, who is pressurising her to take their relationship further. In Italy she meets an American boy, who is also visiting Tuscany, and she thinks he might be the ideal way to get over Tony. He seems to be the perfect gentleman, and Italy introduces Lucy to a world of culture and sophistication. Will she be able to move on from Tony? Or is it a case of out of the frying pan and into the fire?
6uc5rg98dt.note: AbeBooks synopsis for her exact ISBN (Piccadilly Press); publisher copy

u3n6iavgnz.blurb: Then I had an idea. 'How about we get our belly buttons pierced?' There was stunned silence. I don't think they expected that, but I'd been thinking about having it done for a while. Part of a whole new image. I wanted to leave the old Izzie behind. Izzie is restless, and eager to be treated like an adult. So she decides it's time to make some changes. But the new Izzie comes with new problems. First, there is Josh Harper, an older, cute but wild boy. Then there is her mother, who is opposed to every part of the 'new Izzie'. And then there is a night at Nesta's house, when Izzie decides to make cocktails... In the process, Izzie learns a great deal about herself and what it means to be grown up - but not before she's upset just about everyone along the way.
u3n6iavgnz.note: AbeBooks synopsis for her exact ISBN (Piccadilly Press); opens with the extract printed on the back cover

ga48lc6bt4.blurb: Whatever you need to do, you'll know where to look for complete, authoritative instructions. A thorough keyword index will guide you to the exact solution you need. And with 1,001 how-to-solutions, you'll not only find what you're looking for, but also a few things you hadn't considered ... You'll also find lots of special features in the book, including planning calendars, checklists and charts. You can schedule cleaning, gardening and car maintenance tasks using our planning calendars, and you can choose a wine, retirement account or gemstone using our reference charts.
ga48lc6bt4.note: AbeBooks synopsis for her exact ISBN (HarperCollins); reads like the publisher's copy but couldn't be checked on a publisher site

qhzf6i9we4.blurb:
Dead bodies are appearing along the riverbanks of Shinrin, the largest Kingdom in Neputa. There is no explanation as to who has done this, or where these bodies have come from. However, one thing is consistent each time: Gouged out eyes and missing internal organs.

On the night of the next full moon, the infamous masked Mutoren makes another appearance. As Prince Takashi dives into solving this case, it appears that these mysteries may run deeper than he could have ever imagined.
Immerse yourself into the world of Neputa as you join Prince Takashi on his journey into unfolding the mysteries of these horrifying killings. Experience multiple character routes as each story branches out into further mysteries of their own.
qhzf6i9we4.note: Bookshop page carrying the author's blurb (self-published); the author's own site thequestforqieta.com/books has the same text without the middle 'full moon' paragraph

4jim5w7kbx.blurb: Yeah but . . . , I started, then I decided to confront what I thought was probably really bothering her. "Look, about Jonno. I didn't mean for anything to happen. He just kind of . . ." After a game of truth or dare, Lia manages to gain the interest of the school heartthrob, and alienates "teen queen" Kaylie, who was after Jonno for herself. Kaylie and her friends then start a campaign of bullying against Lia - the nasty, underhanded kind where rumors are spread, threats are sent, secrets are exposed, and confidence is underminded. Soon Lia begins to question her whole life: who she is, why these girls have got it in for her, and who her real friends are. . . .

xl1ntkrjps.blurb: Compiled by well known critic, writer and broadcaster, Mary Cadogan, and Blyton archivist, Norman Wright, this treasury contains extracts, short stories and an out-of-print novel from across the range of school stories written by Blyton. Featuring the Naughtiest Girl, Malory Towers and St Clare's, amongst others, this collection will underline Enid Blyton's huge contribution to 20th Century school fiction. Illustrated with black and white line and coloured-up original illustrations, this is a quality book for the gift market - perfect for Blyton fans everywhere!

e980mwz5u2.blurb:
It was the middle of winter and very, very cold. The mice of Brambly Hedge forecasted snow.
And they were right. In the morning they awoke to find their doors and windows hidden behind deep drifts. There hadn't been snow like this for years. "There's enough for a Snow Ball!" cried the mice with glee, and set to work in the time-honoured way to make an Ice Hall for the festivities. The little mice watched wide-eyed as all the preparations were made.
Then at last everything was ready, and the Ball could begin…

add0001.blurb: When Megan, a naive eighteen year old, begins a degree course in English and French at Birmingham University, she has no idea how much her life will begin to parallel the books she is studying. Lurching from one escapade to another, encountering a number of suitable and unsuitable young men, whilst simultaneously having to deal with revelations about her parents and still manage to attend lectures, Megan nevertheless emerges as a sympathetic yet often comic heroine in a novel that blends Bildungsroman with chivalric romance and the picaresque tradition. The story is firmly rooted in the 1980s, following the lives of Megan and her friends in a pre-internet world peppered with both literary and pop-culture allusions. Most importantly, it is a novel about growing up and the difficult decisions faced by all young girls as Megan herself realises that "Literature ..., whether ... French or English, [is] nothing but secrecy and love triangles" and, as life begins to imitate art, must ultimately choose between two very different men in her life.
add0001.note: Google Books for her exact ISBN (independently published 2018, 511 pages); publisher-supplied description, i.e. the author's own

gankwdnbt4.blurb:
Ashwyke Hall has kept its secrets for over a century.
Perched on the cliffs and steeped in tradition, the school presents itself as a place of discipline, excellence, and history. Generations of students have passed through its halls without question, accepting its rituals, its rules, and its carefully preserved image. Most never look beyond what they are meant to see.
But some minds don't work that way.
The Rowan Five notice things others overlook. They think differently, process differently, question differently. Where others see coincidence, they see pattern. Where others accept, they analyse. And when five students who don't follow the same rules all begin to notice the same inconsistencies, it becomes impossible to ignore.
It starts small.
A door that is always locked, but never spoken about. Records that should exist, but don't. Dates that don't align. Spaces that feel... wrong. At first, each of them holds their observations alone, unsure whether to trust what they're seeing. But when their paths cross, the fragments begin to form something far more unsettling.
A pattern.
The deeper they look, the more Ashwyke begins to unravel.
Archived documents have been altered. Entire sections of the school's history are missing. Certain names appear, disappear, and reappear where they shouldn't. Staff deflect questions too quickly. Corridors seem to hold echoes of something long buried. And at the centre of it all lies a truth that someone has worked very hard to keep hidden.
This isn't an accident.
The past hasn't been lost. It has been deliberately erased.
As the Rowan Five begin to piece together what was taken, they realise they are not just uncovering history, they are disturbing it. The closer they get to the truth, the more resistance they face. Subtle at first. Then undeniable.
Warnings.
Shifts in behaviour. Doors that should open, suddenly don't. Information that vanishes just as they reach it. It becomes clear that Ashwyke is not just a place that holds secrets, it protects them.
And now, it knows they're looking.
Each of the five brings something different to the search: logic, intuition, memory, pattern recognition, and perspective. Alone, their insights might be dismissed. Together, they form something far more powerful, a way of seeing the school as it truly is.
Not as it presents itself.
But as it was.
And as it still might be.
Five students. Five perspectives. One conspiracy buried deep within the walls of Ashwyke Hall.
A legacy built on silence. A history rewritten. And a truth that refuses to stay hidden any longer.
Because once you see the pattern...
You can't unsee it.

add0010.blurb:
How can one small human defy a ruler of worlds?
The only Earth-born human among a species scattered to the stars, Kali is now a celebrity on Antaris, revered by its human population as the living embodiment of the goddess Callista.
Following the events of The Callista Alignment , this sequel continues The Natural Human Saga as Kali’s influence continues to rise. Sent on a diplomatic mission to neighbouring Decca, she is plunged into a world of intrigue and violence where nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted. When a mysterious slave ship appears in its orbit, Kali is drawn into a perilous dispute between interstellar powers and pitted against a ruthless ruler determined to destroy her.
With the odds stacked against her, can Kali save the ship’s cargo of humans? Can she even save herself?

add0006.blurb: The Protectors of the Land have been torn from each other, forced to go back to the Dimension of their birth. No one could have foreseen the drastic repercussions of this act on the Protectors, their loved ones, and the Grid. Desperate and ill, the Protectors vow to turn their back on the Land and the constant struggle against Evil in order to live with one another again. Yet finding a way to pierce the dimensions, bring their group back together again, and evade the notice of the Grid Managers is a daunting task. One, it turns out, the Protectors are more than up to managing.

add0008.blurb:
The Quests Continue!
Janet Noxx, an event planner in upstate New York, is thrilled when superstar Zach Neol chooses her company for his upcoming wedding. Little does she know that her involvement in the celebration will lead to a life-changing adventure. After accidently traveling to the Land, Janet finds herself in the middle of a counterpart dilemma which makes her question relationships back in the World Dimension. Thrust into the middle of the wizarding power struggle erupting throughout the Land, Janet also discovers Void personnel are scrutinizing the Protector interaction in the dimension. With each interaction and intersection between the Dimensions Janet must question her abilities and constantly evaluate her place in the Interdimensional arena.
The clash between multiple Dimensions culminates in an epic battle between Good & Evil. The outcome of the conflict will ultimately determine the fate of the Protectors and their futures.
add0008.note: Amazon Kindle listing (NBTR 2012, Quest book 11), publisher-supplied; her copy has no ISBN recorded, so edition unconfirmed ('accidently' is in the source)

add0007.blurb:
The Quests continue…
After the devastating battles of the Sea Dimension, the Protectors are focused on ensuring those most affected by the tragedy of their exile are safe and healing. Yet Evil continues to harass and endanger their lives both in the Land and World. The Land is beset by a serial killer preying on the populace, and does not possess the skills or mindset to capture such a beast. When another Worlder is tapped to join the fight, the Protectors must overcome their fears to ensure the newest member of their group is fully equipped for the endeavor. The newest recruit has a unique-and perhaps dangerous-link to their past that could unravel their cover in the World Dimension.
The 13th in the Quest Series, Guardian Quest continues the saga of the Land Dimension, fighting Evil in its purest form, and the Worlders who assist in the battle.
